roads.name: US Highway 64
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 3.0 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 6,673 to 6,965 ft, with 366 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 35 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.20 g.
